question.problem:
In a factory, two machines independently produce the same product. The random variable $X$ represents the number of rejects per day of the first machine, and the random variable $Y$ is the number of rejects per day on another machine. The probability distributions of $X$ and $Y$ are given below.
$x$ $0$ $1$ $2$ $3$
$f(x)$ $0.1$ $0.6$ $0.2$ $0.1$
$y$ $0$ $1$ $2$
$f(y)$ $0.5$ $0.3$ $0.2$

Calculate the expected number of items per day that the factory rejects.
question.worked_solution:
We need to calculate $\text{E}[X+Y].$

Recall that if $X$ and $Y$ are random variables (not necessarily independent), and $a$ and $b$ are constants, then

$$
\text{E}[aX+bY]=a\text{E}[X]+b\text{E}[Y].
$$

The expected values of $X$ and $Y$ are calculated as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =0\cdot 0.1+1\cdot 0.6+2\cdot 0.2+3\cdot 0.1=1.3 \\ \text{E}[Y] & =0\cdot 0.5+1\cdot 0.3+2\cdot 0.2=0.7\end{aligned}
$$

Hence, we get

$$
\text{E}[X+Y]=\text{E}[X]+\text{E}[Y]=1.3+0.7=2.
$$
